defined_text = {
    name = GVA233_BG_BudgetedMPL
    random = no
    text = {
        trigger = {
            check_variable = { which = qcw value = 10 }
        }
        localisation_key = GVAP_5
    }
    text = {
        trigger = {
            check_variable = { which = qcw value = 0 }
        }
        localisation_key = GVAP_12

    text = {

            NOT = { check_variable = { which = qcw value = -9.999 } }
        }
        localisation_key = GVAP_0
    }
    text = {
        localisation_key = GVAP_7
    }
}
